audit_result: No existing untouched Research2 EVAL trace/capture artifacts found in repository evidence/data paths during R2-09B contract freeze (search over tracked repo paths for EVAL/r2 trace/capture artifacts). Absence is documented; R2-09B freezes acquisition/design contract only.

design_decision.label: DESIGN_DECISION_NOT_STATISTICALLY_POWERED
design_decision.choice: Smallest balanced held-out design supporting per-workload-family reporting: 4 new EVAL workload specifications (1 per family: coding, reasoning, summarization, instruction) x 1 deterministic capture each = 4 primary EVAL capture cells under the frozen deterministic condition. Replicate/robustness extensions require explicit contract amendment before EVAL opening if scientifically justified.
design_decision.rationale: Balances all four II-B workload families while keeping acquisition minimal and avoiding invented sample sizes. Supports per-(budget,workload-family) reporting for the frozen primary deterministic condition. Not a statistically powered sample-size claim.

model_identity.name: Qwen3-30B-A3B-Q4_K_M
model_identity.status: MUST_MATCH_FROZEN_RESEARCH2_PROTOCOL_AT_ACQUISITION; record actual artifact path/SHA in acquisition manifest

deterministic_capture_conditions.seed_policy: Record explicit acquisition seed per cell; deterministic decoding protocol follows II-B/R2-08 convention. Seed field is metadata/replicate identifier; any seed effect under deterministic greedy decoding must be reported, not assumed zero.
deterministic_capture_conditions.context_limits: Record actual context/runtime limits in acquisition manifest; must be consistent across a cell comparison unless explicitly versioned.
deterministic_capture_conditions.expert_memory_capture_budget_relevance: Expert-memory budget is a replay/evaluation parameter (1.5/4/8 GiB primary). Trace capture budget/configuration must be recorded and consistent with Research2 trace schema/protocol.

trace_schema_and_validation.trace_schema: Research2 R2Trace/routing trace schema used by canonical II-A/II-B pipeline (or explicitly versioned compatible schema)
validation_requirements: SHA256 recorded for trace and workload spec
replay contract compatibility checks pass before EVAL analysis
rejection_retry_rules: retry at most once per cell with identical frozen spec; if retry differs, record both and mark cell INCONCLUSIVE pending review
do not tune prompts/specs after observing EVAL trace quality except by creating a new benchmark version

state_machine: EVAL_CAPTURED_SEALED (captured, not inspected for method selection)
acquisition_protocol.when_results_visible: No EVAL performance/result may be inspected until B_selected (R2-09A) and the selected R2-10 predictor/config are frozen under this contract and EVAL_OPENED is recorded.
acquisition_protocol.post_eval_method_change: Creates a new experimental generation/version; old EVAL becomes DEV/observed for that new generation and a new held-out EVAL is required for fresh confirmatory claims.
